name: Jo Ba-reun
bio: Jo Ba-reun is a South Korean director and screenwriter.

credits.title: Wild Eyes: The Woman of the Prince
credits.overview: Eun Woo infiltrates the palace to kill Crown Prince Lee Hyun, only to fall in love with him.

credits.title: Even If This Love Disappears Tonight
credits.overview: A high school girl wakes up each day with no memory of yesterday. When she agrees to date a shy classmate, can their love grow with every new beginning?

credits.title: Ghost Train
credits.overview: Da-kyung, a horror YouTuber desperate for views, uploads a video about the eerie urban legends surrounding Gwanglim Station—the site of the highest number of missing person cases in the country. credits.title: Floor
credits.overview: His perfect home has just one flaw — The unrelenting noise from upstairs. For neighbors who refuse to listen, maybe fists will have to do the talking instead.

credits.title: Ghost Mansion
credits.overview: A horror webtoon writer journeys to a shabby apartment building in search of ideas. The building's caretaker tells him about multiple strange events that happened throughout the building's history.

credits.title: Slate
credits.overview: Yeon-hee always had dreams of becoming a heroine. Now in her late 20s, she is transported from a movie set to a parallel world where she gets the chance to live her dream.

credits.title: GANG
credits.overview: Choi Jihoon is assigned to Daehun High School, the worst high school in Korea. He pledges to be the ‘Jjang (Top gangster)’ here, but the reality is quite tough.

credits.title: Vibration
credits.overview: When Mr Wang sorts the possessions of his recently deceased wife, he finds something which will change how he views her, and himself.
